name: 20 Oz. Kaden Stainless Steel Tumbler
description: Bring along a cup of your favorite wake up in the cool and colorful Kaden steel mug. This big 20 ounce capacity tumbler is made of vacuum-insulated stainless steel with a BPA free construction that can maintain the temperature of al kinds of hot and cold beverages. The tall design features a thin handle and sip-though lid. Choose from five colors and add your school, sports team, organizational or company logo, emblem or message to customize.
